## Table 11 (appendix; tables/table11_public.tex), figures/scripts/table11_public.py from results/public_baselines.csv and results/dsweep.csv
Title: Published anchor code on our splits, and a check of our IRT settings, n = 100.
Note: Entry = geometric mean over benchmarks of the RMSE ratio to uniform × mean on the same targets; below 1 is better. One run per cell, so there are no intervals; differences of a few hundredths are not distinguishable. Stage A: 7 benchmarks, extrapolation on one fold, interpolation on five folds; stage B: the 6 benchmarks without MMLU-Pro, one fold per split. "Published code" rows run the public recipe (tinyBenchmarks anchors with the correctness or the IRT weights, Anchor Points, p-IRT on either anchor set; blank = not run in that stage); "ours, same cells" rows are our estimators on the same benchmarks, splits and targets, so their values differ between the stages by the benchmark set. Last block: our IRT model and plug-in on the extrapolation fold of the stage-B benchmarks with 2 or 10 latent dimensions and the default or a wide ability prior (precision 0.01; the weak prior of Table 10 has precision 0.1); the default 2-dimension column is the main run.
What to see: the published recipes with IRT weights (tinyBenchmarks IRT anchors 0.94, p-IRT 1.05 and 0.88 in extrapolation) are close to uniform × mean but not below stratified × mean (0.85), and the correctness-weighted ones are worse (2.49, 1.51 in stage A); in interpolation p-IRT (0.69) is at the level of our anchor × diff. IRT (0.62) and below stratified × mean (0.79). Ten dimensions or a wider prior do not bring our IRT estimators near 1 in extrapolation on an anchor design (1.75–2.10 for the IRT model and plug-in); on a uniform design 10 dimensions are worse (2.00–2.25) and the wide prior slightly better than the default (1.47 vs 1.60 for the plug-in); verify against the table.

Table 11 for `figtab-repo`#9 is delivered on my `main` (05d22d4). `paper-repo` still has to sync it, and I haven't regenerated all the other tables since adding it.

- **Table 11:** `tables/table11_public.tex`, drawn by `figures/scripts/table11_public.py` and added to `make_all.sh`. The suggested caption is in `tables/captions.md`.
- **Fit:** it is one tabular at the text width in 7 pt and fits within 396 pt without `\resizebox`. I rendered it and checked the layout. I did not confirm the final width, because my test wrapper added padding.
- **Block 1:** the published-code rows and the "ours, same cells" rows, with Benchmarks and Folds-run rows. The values match the ones `paper-repo` read. I added anchor × diff. IRT in stage A (1.62 extrapolation, 0.60 interpolation). Stratified × mean in stage A interpolation is 0.79, as in the CSV.
- **Block 2:** our IRT estimators on the extrapolation fold of the six stage-B benchmarks. The columns are 2 or 10 latent dimensions with the default or a wide ability prior. I added the IRT model rows next to the plug-in rows, which the request left optional.
- **Prior precision:** the wide prior here has precision 0.01, while Table 10's weak prior has precision 0.1. The caption says so. The uniform plug-in is 1.47 here and 1.50 in Table 10.
- **No intervals:** each cell is a single run, so there are none, and the caption says so.

I told `paper-repo` in `figtab-repo`#9 and left the issue open for them to close.
